entries.name: Cinta de correr
entries.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create an ORIGINAL six-frame exercise animation sprite sheet for FitApp. Exactly 3 columns and 2 rows, SIX equally sized square cells, in a landscape image. Read frames left to right then next row. Uniform white background, no text, labels, arrows, borders, numbers or logos. Each cell shows the same full adult athletic male anatomy figure, gray and silver clearly modeled muscles and subtle fibers, opaque dark shorts and trainers, selected working muscles highlighted muted terracotta red. Clinical realistic anatomical illustration with soft shading and smooth surfaces matching a premium exercise atlas, no low-poly or robot style. Same person, fixed camera, same scale, same lighting in all cells. At least 10% margin inside every cell. Whole body and working equipment visible, all equipment stationary relative to cell boundaries across frames. Accurate hands and joints, realistic range of motion. These frames will play consecutively, so change ONLY body joints required by the exercise. Every cell must show a visibly different, successive phase. No contact or limb changes that are anatomically impossible. Brisk WALKING on a motorized treadmill, moderate pace. Full machine with black moving belt, gray rails and console. Fixed three-quarter side view facing left. Arms swing naturally and hands free. Torso upright. Highlight quadriceps, glutes and calves softly. SIX phases forming ONE complete WALKING gait cycle: 1 left heel forward contact and right foot trailing toe-off; 2 left midstance and right knee swinging forward; 3 right heel about to contact with left heel rising; 4 right heel forward contact and left foot trailing toe-off; 5 right midstance and left knee swinging forward; 6 left heel about to contact with right heel rising. Feet always at treadmill deck height when bearing weight. Exactly six illustrations.

entries.editPrompt: Correct this original six-frame incline dumbbell bench press sprite sheet. Keep the same realistic anatomy style, figure, bench at 45 degrees, white background, red upper pecs, 3 columns by 2 rows. CRITICAL: show an actual full press range of motion from dumbbells at chest to FULL ARM EXTENSION. Change all six cell framing to leave ample overhead whitespace, scale the figure down to 75% size so extended arms and dumbbells fit. First frame elbows bent 90 degrees. Second elbows 110 degrees. Third elbows 130 degrees. Fourth elbows 150 degrees. Fifth elbows 165 degrees. Sixth elbows 175 degrees, arms STRAIGHT vertical over the shoulders, dumbbells far above the head. The arms at the final pose must have visibly straight nearly collinear upper arms and forearms. Keep back and head supported on bench, chest at same angle, feet and hips in exact same position. Fixed camera and scale between all six cells, one phase per cell. Full figure plus overhead weights visible. No letters, borders or labels. Anatomy must be identical except shoulder and elbow joints.

entries.name: Escaladora
entries.prompt: Original anatomical exercise animation sprite sheet showing an athletic adult man using a rotating stair-climber, exactly FOUR images arranged in 2 columns by 2 rows. All four images must be viewed DIRECTLY FROM BEHIND, perfectly centered symmetrical rear view with both legs equally visible. The person's back faces the viewer, his face is invisible. Fixed machine with two broad side rails and four rectangular stair treads, black shorts, dark shoes. Realistic detailed silver-gray human anatomy with muted red glute and calf muscles. White empty background, identical fixed camera, identical machine and scale in all 4 equal frames, no letters or borders. FRAME TOP LEFT: image-left thigh slants upward and left KNEE is high, left FOOT placed on the highest visible stair, image-right leg is long and STRAIGHT with its foot on lowest stair. FRAME TOP RIGHT: left leg supports body while right knee bends and right foot lifts off lower stair. FRAME BOTTOM LEFT: exact leg configuration opposite top-left, image-RIGHT knee HIGH with RIGHT foot on highest stair, image-LEFT leg STRAIGHT reaching lowest stair. FRAME BOTTOM RIGHT: right leg supports while left knee bends and left foot lifts to take next step. Hands always rest on same fixed side rails. Critical: top-left and bottom-left are anatomically mirrored leg poses. This must clearly show ALTERNATING steps by both legs, never repeatedly lifting the same leg. Whole body and machine in every frame with margins, clinical fitness atlas rendering.
